Trello Guest Awareness 1.0.3 — unpacked installation

1. Extract this folder to a permanent location.
2. Open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions).
3. Enable Developer mode, click Load unpacked, and select this folder.
4. Click the extension toolbar icon to open Settings.
5. Enter a Trello developer API key. Choose Authorization token expiration:
   1 hour, 1 day, 30 days, or Never expires (default). The choice saves
   automatically. Then choose Open read-only authorization.
6. Approve the requested read-only access at Trello, copy the token, paste it
   into Settings, then choose Save & verify. No API secret is required.
7. Reload Trello tabs after installing or reloading this extension.

A guest is a board member outside the board's Trello Workspace membership;
it does not identify their employer. Cancel preserves your comment draft.
Board and card confirmation dismissals are independent and can be restored
in Settings. Membership updates are eventual (normally 60–90 seconds).

The expiration choice applies only to newly issued tokens. Existing tokens
keep their original expiration. Never expires means no scheduled expiration;
tokens can still be revoked or invalidated. Revoke access in your Trello
account settings. Each person must authorize their own token; never share it.

This version was verified on deterministic Trello-like fixtures in Chromium.
Earlier non-posting live Trello checks verified card warnings and Cancel.
Live Post Anyway continuation and Edge acceptance remain outstanding.
Trello supplies no documented stable pre-comment hook or DOM selectors.
Unknown editors and unavailable membership leave native commenting usable;
the extension cannot guarantee pre-submit warnings in those conditions.
Validate on an authorized disposable test board before company rollout.

The full source package includes README.md and docs/ with installation,
privacy, troubleshooting, research, limitations, and the test report.
No backend or analytics. The extension never posts via the Trello API.
Read tokens are stored only in trusted local extension storage. Treat tokens
as private; removing one here does not revoke it at Trello.

To update, replace the files in Chrome's existing loaded folder, click Reload
at chrome://extensions, reopen Settings, and refresh all Trello tabs.
